rotations.name: Wheat, Fallow
evidence: USDA CDL rotation labels for Finney County sample points
risks: Confirm rotation fits your equipment and markets.
data_gaps: Crop health quantiles require trained models (AppEEARS NDVI pending).

rotations.name: Wheat, Sorghum, Fallow
why: Sorghum can spread income across the rotation cycle.
evidence: 350 sample points labelled wheat–sorghum–fallow in CDL history
data_gaps: Water need uses crop table Kc values when available.

rotations.name: Wheat, Forage (triticale, hay, peas)
why: Forage crops can add ground cover between wheat crops.
evidence: Few Finney County pixels grow peas (CDL 2024)
risks: Forage harvest and marketing differ from grain wheat.
data_gaps: Rotation C has limited training rows; marked low confidence in CURSOR_CONTEXT.

disclaimer: This tool supports, and does not replace, the judgment of farmers and local agricultural experts.
